page.body:
How PropertyList Generates Direct Leads for You


Struggling to find qualified leads? Relying entirely on co-broking or passive networking is no longer enough. The PropertyList ecosystem offers targeted advertising on our public platform to connect you directly with potential buyers and renters who are actively searching for properties.

Our digital infrastructure operates as a comprehensive, one - stop shop to supercharge your lead generation and keep your automated sales pipeline full.

The Two Pillars of Direct Lead Generation

Within the PropertyList network, direct leads flow to your agency through two primary, strategic channels:
  1. MicroSite Leads (Self - Generated) You can actively generate your own direct leads by deploying your free Branded MicroSite. When you upload a property, the system automatically creates a custom, branded URL for that listing. By sharing this link across your network, any inquiries submitted through the built-in lead capture form are funnelled directly into your Smart CRM as an exclusive lead.
  2. Portal Leads (System - Generated) When you need to accelerate a mandate, PropertyList works for you. By featuring your inventory on the public property portal, our platform deploys targeted consumer advertising to generate qualified, direct public leads right to your dashboard.

Expanding Your Reach: Upcoming Features

The PropertyList infrastructure is continuously evolving to provide you with an unbeatable strategic advantage. Our upcoming premium features will further expand your market reach, including:
  • Advanced social media promotion and boosted posts
  • Targeted direct client property emails
  • AI - driven funnels and automated client nurturing
